paper.core_task: Long-context language modeling and knowledge integration for state space models

contributions.name: Chunk-wise long-term memory mechanism for SSMs
contributions.author_claim_text: We introduce a chunk-wise long-term memory mechanism for Mamba-based SSMs. This architectural enhancement significantly mitigates the inherent forgetting problem for information within the input context and improves in-sequence recall over long distances.
contributions.description: A novel architectural enhancement for State Space Models that uses chunked memory to improve internal recall and reduce information forgetting over long sequences.

contributions.name: Pre-training methodology for external knowledge integration

contributions.description: A novel pre-training method to fuse a pre-encoded external knowledge base into an SSM's learning process without text concatenation.

contributions.name: Plastic Unified Memory Network architecture
contributions.author_claim_text: We combine these advancements in our Plastic Unified Memory Network (PUM-Net). We demonstrate that the resulting synergy from the deep integration of both internal and external memory systems leads to substantial improvements on challenging long-context benchmarks.
contributions.description: A unified architecture combining a dynamic internal memory and a static external memory, trained via staged parallel computation, for improved long-context performance.

novelty_claims.text: The proposed dual-memory system is conceptually novel, particularly in its approach to integrating pre-encoded external knowledge into the model's core architecture without relying on raw text concatenation.
